description: Icelandic company register (Fyrirtækjaskrá, Skatturinn): search companies by name (kennitala/ID number, name, address), or look up one company by its 10-digit kennitala for the full public record: name, registration date, other names, postal and legal address, municipality, legal form (ehf., hf., sf....), officers listed by the register, ÍSAT industry classification, and VAT numbers with registration dates. Choose this tool for: Icelandic company register. Close alternatives on this server: b2b_bolagsverket_sweden_companies (Swedish company register record by 10-digit organisation); b2b_brreg_norway_companies (Norway Business Register). Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
